text.p: Spanish international midfielder Josep Guardiola said on Friday that he would stay with Barcelona, ending speculation that he might move to Italian club Parma.
Guardiola, captain of the Catalan club last season, has agreed to a four-year contract, which includes a buy-out clause worth 15 billion pesetas ($100 million).
The 26-year-old player had said he could earn twice as much playing in Italy.

But Guardiola has always been reluctant to leave the club he has been with since he was 13. He was born locally and played in Barcelona's youth and junior system before making his first team debut in 1990.
